description: The VOCABULARY of video motion for the director (owner 10.11.2026, after the research of the official Kling / Kie / Google / xAI guides). Camera moves, light motions and the sentences that freeze the rest. A role or a slot of a set names a move by its id (`camera`, `light`), the director puts the PHRASE into the clip prompt and checks the STATUS. Status: ok = proven or safe; test = allowed but not proven on our murals (the director warns); avoid = not for a mural wall; banned_by_owner = the owner's ban (the same words as BANNED_MOTION in reels_pipeline/director.py: a test keeps the two in step). Evidence: 'ours' = a clip of ours (specs/video_models.json), 'official' = Kling/Kie/Google/xAI page, 'community' = a third-party guide, 'inference' = my reading, not a fact. Promoting this list into Promt/trends.json (so the web app shares it) is an owner decision: that file is edited by other sessions.

locked_off.phrase: The camera does not move at all: it is a fixed, static shot.

evidence.kling26: ours: the person roles (life, play, gaze, leave) say 'on a tripod' and Kling never drew one
evidence.omni12: MEASURED 10.11 on b5c: the older wording 'locked off on a tripod' made Omni DRAW a tripod that fades in on the rug: never write the word tripod for Omni; the mural itself did not move (0.01 px)

locked_off.source: official: kling.ai/topics/make-a-photo-move ('camera locked off', 'background stays still'); ours

walk_in.phrase: The camera advances straight forward into the room at a clearly visible calm walking pace, as if a person is entering, and the nearer objects shift more than the farther ones, giving a natural depth parallax.

evidence.kling26: ours: proven on Listing 45; owner 08.11: do NOT say 'very slowly', say 'clearly visible calm walking pace'

forward_drift_right.phrase: The camera moves forward and drifts a few centimetres to the right at a calm pace, so the nearer objects shift more than the farther ones.

evidence.kling26: ours: Listing 2 mother clip 06.11, the owner liked it (forward AND a few cm right)

slow_pull_back.phrase: The camera slowly pulls back by about 5 percent at a constant speed and keeps the whole mural wall in the frame.
slow_pull_back.source: community: replicate.com xAI Grok readme, film.fun Kling guide. Risk (inference): a pull-back invents the edges that are not in the first frame

gentle_arc.phrase: The camera arcs gently by about 15 degrees around the room at a constant speed and keeps the whole mural wall in the frame.

evidence.omni12: journal of the site: arcs and side glides hallucinate on Omni 1.1; with a first and a last frame the end is fixed, so it is the one case worth testing

push_in.phrase: A slow push-in toward the room at a constant velocity.

evidence.kling26: Kling's own blog lists a slow push-in as a safe move; the owner banned push-in/zoom (creative-ad-auditor, director.py). An open conflict: ask the owner before using it

pan.phrase: A gentle pan right across the room.
pan.source: official: kling.ai blog; owner ban (pan left / pan right)

orbit.phrase: The camera orbits around the room.
orbit.source: community; owner ban; it opens surfaces that the first frame does not show

lateral_glide.phrase: The camera is sliding sideways along the room.

handheld.source: community: picassoia, elser.ai. A shake reads as a distortion of the mural

rack_focus.source: community: elser.ai (Grok). A mural wall must stay sharp (f/8 or smaller in the briefs)

dust_and_sun_patches.phrase: Fine dust drifts slowly through the sunbeam and the warm sunlight patches on the floor shift gently.
dust_and_sun_patches.source: official example: docs.kie.ai Kling 2.1 ('floating dust ... catch the light'); community: everypixel

lamp_glow.phrase: The pendant lamp hangs still and its warm glow breathes very slightly.

branch_shadows.phrase: Soft dappled shadows of leafy branches sway slowly on the wall and on the floor, as in a light breeze: only the shadows move, subtly and low in contrast, and they never change the colours or the drawing of the mural.

evidence.kling26: ours: Listing 2 mother clip 06.11, the owner liked it; failed on Listing 7 when the shadow on the wall was forbidden

window_light_shift.phrase: The soft window light slowly shifts and thin cloud shadows pass over the floor.
window_light_shift.source: official: kling.ai blog ('soft golden sunlight, long shadows'); community: Grok Replicate. Risk (inference): it may recolour the mural

cove_led_fade_in.phrase: The warm LED light in the ceiling cove above the mural fades up gently.
cove_led_fade_in.source: inference, for the build-up reel (the layer with the ceiling and the light)

freeze.mural: The mural on the wall stays perfectly still and unchanged: its drawing, its colours and every painted animal remain exactly as in the first frame.
freeze.room: The ceiling, the walls, the floor and the rug stay perfectly still.
freeze.note: Kling's official rule (make-a-photo-move): name the ONE thing that moves, then say that everything else stays frozen, in positive words ('minimize negative instructions', Kling 4.0 guide). Measured 08.11: the older negative 'ink lock' sentence did NOT hold on Kling 2.6 (the mural balloon drifted 41 px of 960); whether this positive wording holds is still untested, so measure it (the drift check in AGENTS.md 09.11).

prompt_rules.rule: Prompt = subject + movement. The picture is already known to the model: describe only what MOVES, do not re-describe the photo.
prompt_rules.source: official: kling.ai image-to-video guide; community: Grok Replicate

prompt_rules.rule: One subject, one action, one camera move per clip.
Say what you want in positive words. Kie's Kling 2.6 has no negative_prompt and no cfg_scale; Kling 4.0's guide says negative instructions can raise the error rate.
prompt_rules.source: official: docs.kie.ai Kling 2.6; kling.ai Kling 4.0 user guide

prompt_rules.rule: Numbers beat adjectives: 'about 5 percent', 'about 15 degrees total', 'constant velocity'. 'drift', 'settle', 'hold' give restrained motion, 'dramatic' does not.
prompt_rules.source: community: omnely.com (not confirmed by an official page)

prompt_rules.rule: A picture that looks like a painting may be answered with a pan across the painting: the freeze sentence names the mural as part of the wall.
A single continuous shot, no scene cuts; describe the roles of the pictures in plain language, never with control tags such as <FIRST_FRAME>; no quotation marks; describe the sound.
prompt_rules.source: official: Google guide (via specs/video_models.json), Google Omni 1.2 docs

prompt_rules.rule: A description that deviates strongly from the image can cause a camera cut or a transition.
